[SWS_CM_10516] Invoke receive handler
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004
⌈
In case a receive handler was registered using the
SetReceiveHandler()
method
(see [SWS_CM_00250]) of the respective
Trigger
class for the trigger determined
according to [SWS_CM_10514] this registered receive handler shall be invoked when
the corresponding Trigger is received.
⌋
